paragraphs.text: Ramiro Alcázar Peniche participated in Shipment TCT-10-01 on 2010-10-30. Red del Horizonte Azul was linked to Shipment TCT-10-01 on 2010-10-30. Shipment TCT-10-01 occurred at Tecate on 2010-10-30. Regional press reporting from the border described a load of 400 kg of cannabis that moved through the Tecate crossing toward San Diego in a tractor-trailer that columnists identified as Tráiler Luz Dorada, a unit previously photographed at an Ensenada boatyard. One column named Alcázar, called El Remo along the coast, as the organizer and described him as the maritime logistics figure for the Tijuana network now using the land crossing for bulk loads.

Gonzalo Ferreira Luján led Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2014-11-20. The same column described Ferreira as the head of the network since its formation and stated that the shift of bulk cannabis from pangas to the Tecate crossing reflected his judgment that the maritime route had become too visible. The press account cited unnamed sources in the trucking community and offered no documentary support.

This digest summarizes open press reporting and carries no classification beyond the public domain. The reporting office has not corroborated the press accounts through its own sources. Regional border columnists in this period were known to publish information supplied by rival crews, and the reporting office cannot exclude that the identification of the tractor-trailer was intended to draw inspection attention to it. The quantity reported is the figure printed in the column and has not been verified. Readers should note that the same column has been accurate on vehicle identifications in the past.
